stem: Why are the stage directions in lines 16 and 18 important to the play?

options.label: A
options.text: They show that Maggie and Allen have more experience with whale-watching than Sophia does.

options.label: B
options.text: They reveal that Sophia is not being considerate of what her friends are saying.

options.label: C
options.text: They reveal that Sophia is not experiencing the full benefits of the tour.

options.label: D
options.text: They show that Maggie and Allen are more interested in seeing a whale than Sophia is.
